name: tail-ipam
description: Allocate and plan Tailscale address space through a local, comment-preserving registry and read-only control-plane inventory.
sanitization: TAILSCALE_SANITIZE=off|identity|strict sanitizes rendered output after collection; a non-off environment value overrides --sanitize. Device names, addresses, and routes; tailnet routing keys; site names; service identities; reservation owners; reserved subnet CIDRs; reserved service addresses; and UDP-port site and device labels are replaced. UDP port numbers remain visible. strict is accepted for cross-tool flag compatibility and is currently equivalent to identity for tail-ipam. calc split, aggregate, and info output (stateless arithmetic over CLI-supplied CIDRs) is not sanitized because it contains no tailnet-derived data; calc next-free output reflects registry and live-route data and is sanitized. Set TAILSCALE_SANITIZE_KEY (64 hex characters) for stable tailnet-scoped placeholders; without it placeholders are artifact-scoped.
